zh: 模式串只有 3 个字符，可以按“已经匹配了模式的前几个字符”来分类计数，状态只有 0、1、2、3 四种。
设 dp[j] 为在已扫描的文本前缀中选位置、拼出模式前 j 个字符的方案数，初始 dp[0]=1。读到一个文本字符时，如果它等于模式第 j 个字符，就能接在每个 dp[j−1] 方案后面；为了不让同一个文本位置被用两次，j 要从大到小更新。
依次读入文本字符 c：对 j=3,2,1，若 c 等于 pattern[j−1]，则 dp[j]+=dp[j−1]；扫描结束输出 dp[3]。结果最大约 2×10^16，用 64 位整数。
en: The pattern has only 3 characters, so you can classify the counts by how many leading pattern characters have been matched: just the four states 0, 1, 2, 3.

Let dp[j] be the number of ways to choose positions in the scanned text prefix that spell the first j pattern characters, with dp[0]=1 initially. When a text character equals the j-th pattern character, it can extend every dp[j-1] way; update j from large to small so that the same text position is never used twice.
For each text character c, for j=3,2,1: if c equals pattern[j-1], do dp[j]+=dp[j-1]. After the scan, print dp[3]. The result can reach about 2*10^16, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain, updating in reverse order, the number of ways to match the first 0, 1, 2, 3 characters of the pattern; initially dp[0]=1.

## Correctness

After a prefix of the text has been processed, dp[j] counts the ways to choose positions from that prefix that form the first j characters of the pattern. When a new character matches the j-th character of the pattern, it can be appended to every way counted in the old dp[j-1]; updating in reverse order ensures the same text position is not used twice. Adding the old ways that do not choose the current character keeps the invariant.

## Complexity

Time O(text length), extra space O(1).
